experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, bourbon, cola
Occasion: Quick dark-profile smoke, after a meal, outdoor break
entry.summaryHtml: Espresso, black pepper, earth, cocoa and cedar with a caramel edge give the Disciple a dark, punchy profile. It comes across as robust and savoury rather than especially intricate, with enough sweetness to soften the pepper and roasted notes. The 46 ring feels noticeably chunky for such a short cigar, which is the main ergonomic drawback.
